content: Based on the vector sequence $\mathbf {x}_1\mathbf {x}_2\cdots \mathbf {x}_n$ , we extract higher-level features $\mathbf {h}_1^{\text{ner}}\mathbf {h}_2^{\text{ner}}\cdots \mathbf {h}_n^{\text{ner}}$ by using a bidirectional LSTM module and a simple feed-forward neural layer, which are then used for CRF tagging at the next step.
